title: Minecraft BEST INFINITE Tripwire Hook + EMERALD Farm 1.21!
description:
In this video, I’ll be teaching you how to create the next-generation Emerald Farm powered by Tripwire mechanics! This new style of string farm, introduced in the latest Minecraft versions, is capable of producing between ~39,600 and 80,300 emeralds per hour thanks to a unique placement trick that speeds things up by about 20% more. The best part? It doesn’t rely on costly items; it’s all based on mechanics already built into the game. Let’s jump in and make this together in Minecraft!

I hope you enjoy the video!! 🙏🥰
